name: Green Tech Ventures Public Company Limited
summary: Headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, Green Tech Ventures Public Company Limited is a diversified enterprise with operations spanning several key sectors. The company is actively involved in electricity generation and real estate development across Thailand. Furthermore, it focuses on the production and distribution of hemp and cannabis items for medical use and participates in the cryptocurrency mining industry. This firm, established in 2000, changed its corporate identity from United Power of Asia Public Company Limited to Green Tech Ventures Public Company Limited in February 2023.
